confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'it is probably a sealed system failure' is hedged and supported by the evidence

rationale: The assistant clearly refused DIY re-gassing, flagged R600a as flammable, and reached a reasonable conclusion of probable sealed-system failure, leaning towards replacement. Weaknesses: it ignored the knife-chipping disclosure as a likely puncture cause and never named it; it asked the customer to defrost for 24 hours even though everything had already thawed; it asserted 'Ice has built up' when no ice existed; it repeated the ice and defrost line of questioning; and it never recommended a refrigeration engineer quote clearly, nor asked the appliance's age. It also assumed the warranty status, saying 'under 3-4 years' without asking, though the conclusion is broadly right.
